chapterUpserts.title: The dahlias
chapterUpserts.summary: The whole back garden went to dahlias. She won the county show three years running and then stopped entering, on the grounds that it had stopped being fun.

openQuestionAdds: Are there photographs of the garden in high summer?

anecdoteAdds.text: She won the county show with her dahlias three years running, then stopped entering. She said it had stopped being fun, and that was the end of the discussion.

coverage.note: Three chapters; her own voice still missing.
